title: Probiotics selection for low-lactose fermented goat milk products
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2026, 4,1596-1614
DOI: 10.1039/D5FB00668F, Paper

Mariia Antsyperova, Tamara Arseneva, Aleksei Fedorov, Elena Lemeshonok, Lyudmila Zabodalova, Denis Baranenko
Among the twelve industrial probiotic strains examined, Bifidobacterium bifidum BB01 exhibited the most rapid fermentation of low-lactose goat milk, producing a stable probiotic product suitable for lactose-intolerant consumers.
